mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Native-style HUB source labels and a clearer USB eject selector.
mods.description:
LINK MODE CHANGE: Select PRO DJ LINK mode before loading hub tracks. Switching On/Off briefly disconnects hub sources and can leave source-unavailable warnings and finite cached playback. This issue remains unresolved.

Browse and load USB sticks connected through a hub. Hub sources now show HUB / USB1–8 in Source and Browse, and H / USB1–8 in Waveform. Native USB icons and lettering are reused on the AZ; only additional numerals3–8 use the closest native font. The eject selector has a matching dark design and stable source numbers. Short-press USB STOP to select one stick; hold to eject the hub. Wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Four local decks with Link off, or two with external Link on. Hub libraries remain local and are not shared with external CDJs. Source/Browse/Waveform appearance was approved on the real AZ; prior network validation used a software peer over Wi-Fi. Actual-CDJ, phase-sync, eight-source hardware and long-session use remain unvalidated. Exact firmware2.00, kernel4.4.194 and core>=1.2.3. AZ-MODS stages files internally. The immutable package retains its tested candidate description.
